options.name: api_job_token
options.description: GitLab CI job token for logging in.

options.name: api_oauth_token
options.description: GitLab OAuth token for logging in.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to use for authentication against the API.

options.name: api_token
options.description: GitLab access token with API permissions.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The resolvable endpoint for the API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to use for authentication against the API.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The CA certificates bundle to use to verify GitLab server certificate.

options.name: hook_url
options.description: The URL that you want GitLab to post to, this is used as the primary key for updates and deletion.

options.name: hook_validate_certs
options.description: Whether GitLab performs SSL verification when triggering the hook.

options.name: issues_events
options.description: Trigger hook on issues events.

options.name: job_events
options.description: Trigger hook on job events.

options.name: merge_requests_events
options.description: Trigger hook on merge requests events.

options.name: note_events
options.description: Trigger hook on note events or when someone adds a comment.

options.name: pipeline_events
options.description: Trigger hook on pipeline events.

options.name: project
options.description: ID or Full path of the project in the form of group/name.

options.name: push_events
options.description: Trigger hook on push events.

options.name: push_events_branch_filter
options.description: Branch name of wildcard to trigger hook on push events.

options.name: releases_events
options.description: Trigger hook on release events.

options.name: state
options.description: When V(present) the hook is updated to match the input or created if it does not exist. When V(absent) hook is deleted if it exists.

options.name: tag_push_events
options.description: Trigger hook on tag push events.

options.name: token
options.description: Secret token to validate hook messages at the receiver. If this is present it always results in a change as it cannot be retrieved from GitLab. It shows up in the C(X-GitLab-Token) HTTP request header.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not to validate SSL certs when supplying a HTTPS endpoint.

options.name: wiki_page_events
options.description: Trigger hook on wiki events.
